en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with the technical equipment and techniques used in forestry, with particular regard to the principles of multicriterial decision making of harvesting and transport technologies that respect the protection of forest ecosystems, technical and economic acceptance.
